name: Cleveland Jammers
description: The Cleveland Jammers were a white greaser street gang based in Chicago, Illinois (not New York), originating in the neighborhood north of Cabrini Green in the early to mid 1960s. They were formed by cousins and nephews of the original Little Hell Sharks, a post-WWII Italian gang from the Cabrini Green area. Along with the Mohawks and Hudson Street gang, the Cleveland Jammers merged in the early 1970s to form the CORP, one of the largest white gangs in Chicago at that time.
